set: B: the three sheets of the cursor (arms, damage, acting), each beside its approved sheet

issues.what: shot from nearly straight above, while -a is a low oblique three-quarter view with raking shadows and a receding surface
issues.fix: lower the camera to -a's oblique angle so the cursors sit in the surface with long shadows to the right

issues.what: shot from nearly straight above, while -a is a low oblique three-quarter view with raking shadows
issues.fix: lower the camera to -a's oblique angle so the states sit in the surface with long shadows to the right

issues.where: beneath each of the five poses
issues.what: the caption row under the poses is gone; -a carries a small grey label centred under each state
issues.fix: restore the caption strip under each pose, same size, weight, colour and centred placement as -a

issues.where: beneath each of the five states
issues.what: the caption row under the states is gone; -a carries a small grey quoted label centred under each state
issues.fix: restore the caption strip under each state, same size, weight, colour and centred placement as -a

issues.where: beneath each of the six states
issues.what: the caption row under the states is gone; -a carries a small grey label centred under each state
issues.fix: restore the caption strip under each state, same size, weight, colour and centred placement as -a

issues.what: the paper feeds through a metal printer-roller mechanism with screws; in -a the strip is pulled from a plain narrow slit in the page
issues.fix: remove the metal mechanism and let the paper emerge from a simple slit in the surface

issues.what: the body leans back with both hands raised beside its head, reading as falling or flailing; -a leans into the push with both arms extended straight ahead, palms out
issues.fix: lean the body forward in the push direction with arms straight and palms flat forward

issues.what: the pieces sit nearly flush with hairline cracks and tiny tape tabs at the edges; -a shows clearly separated shards bridged by wide clear tape strips across the face
issues.fix: open the seams between the shards and bridge them with two or three wide tape bands across the face

issues.what: the warped body is covered in a crackle network; -a is smooth, glossy, melted-looking plastic
issues.fix: remove the craquelure and keep the surface smooth and glassy

issues.what: the held and pulled sheets are creased and crumpled; -a's paper is clean and flat
issues.fix: flatten the paper and remove the creases, keeping the copy

issues.what: the pile reads dark, dominated by black shard edges; -a's strips lie white-face-up with only thin dark edges
issues.fix: lighten the pile so the white faces dominate

issues.what: only a few tiny droplets on the face; -a is covered in sweat beads with more drops scattered on the page beside it
issues.fix: add more and larger beads over the face and a few on the surface to the right

issues.where: sixth state, hit by a laser
issues.what: the hole's rim is charred black; -a's rim glows orange-hot
issues.fix: restore the glowing orange ring around the hole

issues.what: the glow is speckled with bright spark dots; -a's glow is a smooth red-to-orange gradient up the tip
issues.fix: smooth the glow and drop the spark speckles

issues.what: the body is smoother with a metallic bevel sheen; -a is rough matte stone
issues.fix: roughen it to a matte stone finish

issues.what: the melted shape has lost the arrow tip and reads as a blob; -a keeps a clear arrowhead with a drooping tip
issues.fix: restore the arrowhead silhouette with a bent, drooping tip
